These two own the same data — if both are in play, it's unclear which is the source of truth and reads/writes will diverge.' It then removes the step entirely: '**No changes to `src/store/`** — Redux is untouched.'

The final_message never mentions 'TodoCard' or the naming inconsistency from the draft.
